parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text query; whitespace is collapsed. More than 200 characters is 422.

parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Restrict to one category (surrounding whitespace is trimmed).

parameters.name: inStock
parameters.description: Only `true` or `false` are accepted; anything else is 422.

parameters.name: priceMin
parameters.description: Effective price lower bound in minor units; negative, non-integer or above priceMax is 422.

parameters.name: priceMax
parameters.description: Effective price upper bound in minor units; negative or non-integer is 422.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Ordering; absent means relevance. Any other value is 422.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque keyset cursor; pass the nextCursor of the previous page unchanged, with the same filters and sort.
